correctness.rationale: The complete seven-neighbor modular calculation yields precisely the P- and Q-tetrahedra for every n>=6; all four stated phase pairs have a unique remaining coface, giving 6n elementary collapses to a triangulated Mobius band and a boundary winding of twice its primitive core. The standalone checker enumerates all cliques from BFS distances, checks exact coface counts for n=6..30 and produces 36 actual elementary reductions to a connected closed Euler-characteristic-two surface for n=5. The proof handles all quantifiers, with finite checks only corroborative.

value.rationale: This infinite-family theorem identifies the sharp exceptional sphere-to-Mobius transition in a natural graph-power Rips filtration, gives reproducible elementary collapse counts and distinguishes its nonprimitive boundary winding from its torsion-free first homology. The index-two phenomenon has genuine integral geometric information not determined by Betti numbers or the untwisted prism result.
